plain_english_policy: Incentivizing agricultural production of biofuel crops via financial subsidies

effects.rationale: Directly promotes agricultural output for biofuel production, expanding resource use.
Financial incentives to grow biofuel crops may encourage land conversion (e.g., forests/grasslands) or increased agricultural runoff, weakening environmental protections.
Biofuel production aligns with resource development over preservation of natural ecosystems.

evidence_quote: providing financial incentives to farms that produce biofuel crops
